hook.rumour: Someone scuttled a silk-barge right across Cheydinhal's Corbolo canal lock, and now the Dunmer banking-house and the old Nibenese silk-gentry are hiring blades against each other.
hook.notice: CHEYDINHAL CANAL CHANCERY: Neutral investigators sought to examine the scuttled silk-barge in the Corbolo Lock before the Charter Assize convenes.

stages.objective: Inspect the augered hull timbers of the sunken barge in Cheydinhal's Corbolo canal
Question the young noblemen at the Knights of the Thorn Lodge who witnessed the night watch
Report the foreign auger-marks to both banking factors in Cheydinhal

objectives.text: Inspect the augered hull timbers of the sunken barge in Cheydinhal's Corbolo canal
Question the young noblemen at the Knights of the Thorn Lodge who witnessed the night watch
Report the foreign auger-marks to both banking factors in Cheydinhal

consequence_detail.summary: The barge was sunk with a sapper's brace stamped in the Imperial City, not by either Cheydinhal faction.

stages.objective: Trace the discounted promissory notes from Cheydinhal's counting-houses south toward Harlun's Watch
Recover the burned silk-warehouse tally from the factor's clerk at Harlun's Watch
Verify the Valus caravan bullion receipts with the smiths at Shurgak Clan Estate

objectives.text: Trace the discounted promissory notes from Cheydinhal's counting-houses south toward Harlun's Watch
Recover the burned silk-warehouse tally from the factor's clerk at Harlun's Watch
Verify the Valus caravan bullion receipts with the smiths at Shurgak Clan Estate

consequence_detail.summary: A shell brokerage run by Arbiter Flavius Olo has been buying up defaulted notes from both Dunmer and Nibenese merchants.

stages.objective: Follow the debt-collectors south from Shurgak Clan Estate along the basin road
Intercept the Council of Ash courier at Cropsford and seize the sealed Charter instructions
Carry the intercepted instructions back to Castle Cheydinhal

objectives.text: Follow the debt-collectors south from Shurgak Clan Estate along the basin road
Intercept the Council of Ash courier at Cropsford and seize the sealed Charter instructions
Carry the intercepted instructions back to Castle Cheydinhal

consequence_detail.summary: The intercepted dispatch proves Arbiter Olo was ordered by the Council of Ash to bankrupt both Cheydinhal banks and seize the Corbolo toll.

stages.objective: Escort the Cropsford silk-witnesses north to the Charter Assize in Cheydinhal
Defeat Arbiter Flavius Olo's hired enforcers at the Corbolo canal warehouse
Witness Count Andel Indarys seal the Joint Corbolo Canal Charter between Dunmer and Nibenese houses

objectives.text: Escort the Cropsford silk-witnesses north to the Charter Assize in Cheydinhal
Defeat Arbiter Flavius Olo's hired enforcers at the Corbolo canal warehouse
Witness Count Andel Indarys seal the Joint Corbolo Canal Charter between Dunmer and Nibenese houses

consequence_detail.summary: Dunmer and Nibenese merchant houses form a joint clearing-house under Count Indarys, expelling the Council of Ash's brokers.
